purpose_context: Nichthub will move from a bounded protocol experiment to an operational self-hosting alpha by adding safe policy evolution, planned key rotation across distinct device actors, selective bounded replication, shallow-clone recovery, and a real role-distinct public development workflow without relying on GitHub collaboration features or a Nichthub server.
purpose_tldr: Make Nichthub capable of sustaining its own public development with durable identity, governance, and replication controls.
